title: Implement output directory and filename policy
description:
Create OutputPathPolicy, a configurable policy class that determines the output directory and filename for capture files based on user settings, source metadata, timestamp, and format.

Before editing, inspect:
- Any existing src/recording/ files for naming conventions and types
- Any existing settings or configuration types that OutputPathPolicy should reference

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation requirements:
1. Declare class OutputPathPolicy in OutputPathPolicy.hpp. It should accept configuration parameters: base output directory (std::filesystem::path), filename template (std::string with placeholders), and default format extension.
2. Supported filename placeholders: {date}, {time}, {datetime}, {source}, {format}, {samplerate}, {channels}, {counter}. The policy resolves these at capture-start time.
3. Implement resolveOutputPath(metadata) -> std::filesystem::path in OutputPathPolicy.cpp. metadata should carry source name, sample rate, channel count, and format. The method returns the fully resolved absolute path.
4. On resolveOutputPath(), create the output directory if it does not exist (std::filesystem::create_directories). If directory creation fails, return an error or throw.
5. Handle filename collisions: if the resolved path already exists, append an incrementing suffix (_001, _002, etc.) before the extension.
6. Validate the base directory is writable at construction or via a validate() method.
7. Keep the implementation pure C++ standard library (std::filesystem, std::chrono, std::format or ostringstream). No Qt dependency.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
